def main():
    import sys
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    t = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    prefixes_s = [s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s)+1)]
    prefixes_t = [t[:i] for i in range(1, len(t)+1)]
    result = set()
    for p_s in prefixes_s:
        for p_t in prefixes_t:
            result.add(p_s + p_t)
    print(len(result))

main()
